subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] mm: add anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list

2026-10-23.patch_summary: This patch adds anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list, allowing them to be split and reclaimed when under memory pressure. This is necessary because without this change, fully mapped mTHP folios that are mostly zero-filled would not get split by the deferred split shrinker, leading to memory regressions. The patch mirrors the existing behavior for PMD-sized folios and only queues mTHP folios of at least 2M for underused splitting. This is a conservative approach to minimize overhead on the common order-0 fault path.
